subject: general
question:
in the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts - P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Books have always been a source of knowledge. P: They allow us to travel across time and space, Q: We learn about different cultures and civilizations. R: Stories in books fuel our imagination. S: From science to art, books cover every field. 6. Therefore, reading must be encouraged in youth.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the importance of books as a source of knowledge and imagination.
 
• **Sentence P comes first** as it introduces the broad perspective on how books allow us to travel across time and space:
 
 
• "They allow us to travel across time and space."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R follows** as it elaborates on the imaginative aspect of stories in books:
 
 
• "Stories in books fuel our imagination."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q comes next** as it connects the imaginative and cultural aspects of books:
 
 
• "We learn about different cultures and civilizations."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the last** as it broadens the discussion to the wide range of topics that books cover:
 
 
• "From science to art, books cover every field."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PRQS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Books have always been a source of knowledge. They allow us to travel across time and space. Stories in books fuel our imagination. We learn about different cultures and civilizations. From science to art, books cover every field. Therefore, reading must be encouraged in youth."
